verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's own workers-sdk repo ships a simulator for developing and testing Workers locally, powered by workerd, and Wrangler documents commands for developing Workers. The evidence is a one-line repo description, though, and never states that workerd is the same runtime used in production, so parity is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the local simulator matches the production runtime, detail on local emulation of bindings (KV, D1, Queues), and hands-on corroboration of local/production parity.

support.subject: As a developer, I can develop and test my app locally using a simulator that matches the production runtime

citations.quote: A simulator for developing and testing Cloudflare Workers, powered by workerd
The core Wrangler commands for creating, developing, and deploying Workers are on the Workers commands page.
